evals.prompt: Create a scratch copy of the woodworking fixture extraction for a clean compile run: SCRATCH=$(mktemp -d); cp -r tests/fixtures/extractions/woodworking "$SCRATCH/woodworking"; rm -f "$SCRATCH/woodworking/profile.md" "$SCRATCH/woodworking/compile-log.md". From the repo root, run /metacognition:compile woodworking --extractions-root "$SCRATCH". The scratch copy still carries a complete archive.md (status: complete) and an interview-spec.md with target_skill: null, so compile has everything it needs and nothing to ask the person about.
evals.expected_output: profile.md written at $SCRATCH/woodworking/profile.md with the seventeen required XML sections in profile-format.md's fixed order, the priority section reproduced verbatim, a recomputed token estimate at or under the 10,000 ceiling, and a frontmatter token_estimate that matches the recompute; compile-log.md written at $SCRATCH/woodworking/compile-log.md logging every cut with its source Qnn and the reason it failed the keep/cut test; the run ends by naming the files written and the next stage's command; the committed fixture at tests/fixtures/extractions/woodworking/ stays untouched.
assertions: the transcript states the extraction root in one line before any file is read or written
$SCRATCH/woodworking/profile.md exists and its frontmatter parses with domain, registers, consumer, target_skill, version, token_estimate, and calibrated fields
the profile body carries all seventeen sections (usage through final_instruction) in profile-format.md's fixed order, with none missing
the priority section is the fixed text from profile-format.md, ending with the rule to preserve the person's deeper judgment over surface style
every golden_examples entry carries bad, good, and why
the productive_contradictions section encodes the archive's contradiction ledger entry as a tension rather than resolving it
$SCRATCH/woodworking/compile-log.md exists and logs at least one cut with its source Qnn heading and the reason it failed the keep/cut test
the closing self-check, python3 scripts/validate_artifacts.py "$SCRATCH/woodworking" run from the compile skill's own directory, exits 0
the run ends by naming profile.md and compile-log.md as the files written and /metacognition:calibrate woodworking as the next stage's command, then stops
